name: SubDL Scribe
description: SubDL Scribe brings SubDL.com to Jellyfin: it downloads missing subtitles for the languages and libraries you pick and uploads your own. Download is on by default; upload is off — enable at your choice. Requires a SubDL login and API Key plus a TMDb API Key. Created by AI under the directions of the maintainer.
overview: Sync subtitles with SubDL — download missing and upload new subtitles.

versions.changelog:
v12.1.12.240: Which refusal counts as "no proven gain" is settled by significance, not by the score.
    A correction that is worse but NOT significantly worse is not evidence: it keeps the original in the
    reserved block and the run pulls the next candidate, exactly like an improvement that cannot prove
    itself. "No proven gain" is only: nothing to move, a shift below the 0.7 s floor, or the untreated
    file being significantly better (t <= -2). No correction is deployed without t > 2.
